assumptions: Weather steps come from the Fort Pierce ASOS (FPR), about 21.0 km northwest of the plant on the mainland, not from the plant itself.

Each step summarizes the 15 minutes ending at its time, from ASOS 1-minute data: precipMmPerHour = mean 1-min precip (in) x 25.4 x 60; gustKmh = max 1-min gust (kt) x 1.852; tempC = last 1-min temperature (F) converted.

thunderPct is not a forecast probability. It is 100 when an FPR METAR or 5-min HFMETAR in the step's 15 minutes reports TS or VCTS, or a Severe Thunderstorm Warning with coversSite=true is active; otherwise null (unknown, not zero).

coversSite is true when the storm-based polygon contains the plant point, or when the product is county-wide for St. Lucie County (FLC111) or zone-wide for the plant's forecast zone (FLZ159). Alerts whose polygon misses the plant stay in the list with coversSite=false; area gives the distance.

Pop-up storm: no Severe Thunderstorm or Tornado Watch for St. Lucie County was active in the 2 hours before the first warning covering the plant (12:47). Severe Thunderstorm Watch MLB SV.A #258 was issued at 12:53, after that warning.
NCEI Storm Events times are EST (UTC-5) and were converted to EDT (UTC-4).
Missing 1-minute rows are skipped; a field is null only when its whole 15-minute block is missing.
nwsGrid comes from api.weather.gov/points for the site coordinates.
